'''Cooked fish''' is a [[food]] item made by cooking any small fish or a [[Tropical Fish|tropical fish]]. It heals {{Value|Cooked Fish|heals}}. It replaces {{MCW|Cooked Cod|cooked cod}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking ===
Cooked fish is made from anything in the small fish group: [[cod]], the 18 custom fish that are cod (see [[Fish]]) and the [[Tropical Fish|tropical fish]]. One recipe, with the group as its ingredient, replaces the separate cod and tropical fish recipes of 1.12.2. Cooking takes {{Value|Cooked Fish|cook_time}} in an [[Oven]] or on [[Kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_fish.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/item/fish_small.json}}</ref> A [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] chars it instead.
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it gives a hidden Regeneration III for 48 ticks (2.4 seconds), which heals {{Value|Cooked Fish|heals}}. It can be eaten at any time.
